yaw_sign_convention: positive = subject turns to subject's right; negative = subject's left
notes: All thresholds are placeholders pending live GPU calibration.
While calibration_status=uncalibrated, automated_quality_status must never be plain pass.
Clear objective failures still FAIL. Apparently-good uncalibrated results are provisional_pass or inconclusive.
S2 requires magnitude in [yaw_s2_abs_min, yaw_s2_abs_max] AND correct yaw direction (direction_match).
S3 uses face-local mouth landmarks; unavailable landmarks → inconclusive, not pass.
S4 CLIP is local_files_only only; missing local CLIP → unavailable/inconclusive (zero network).
